title: Reject a cursor after the Saga snapshot changes
preconditions: Use querytest.New with at least two children and a fixed source comparison.

steps.action: Read children with limit 1 and retain the cursor.
Advance Saga snapshot using the fixture mutation; repeat children using the old cursor.
steps.expected_result: The CLI returns exit 4, stale_snapshot, retryable=true, rather than a mixed-state page.

expected_result: The caller must restart pagination after a snapshot change.
